key_findings: CBD3A6K-RhB PEG-PLGA nanoparticles given intraneurally inhibited calcium influx and CGRP release in DRG neurons and gave long-lasting anti-allodynia in CCI rats.
Analgesia was associated with reduced CaV2.2 in DRG and spinal cord.
